name: Ty Hen Holiday Park
suitableFor: Families and dog owners wanting a park with on-site activities
dogs: Dogs catered for, with fields and footpaths for walking
beachAccess: Entrance beside Rhosneigr railway station, about half a mile past the village clock
confirmedFeatures: Heated outdoor pool (May to September), sauna, play park, two toilet blocks with free hot showers, laundry, fishing lake, kayak hire, petting animals
overview: Ty Hen sits on the west bank of Llyn Maelog, with its entrance next to Rhosneigr railway station about half a mile from the village centre. The caravan site has a heated outdoor pool in summer, a sauna, a play park and fishing, plus fields and footpaths for walking dogs.
surfTripFit: It is a short trip into Rhosneigr and its beaches, and the pool, showers and laundry make longer family stays straightforward.
